notes.title: BattleLore: Command now $3.99!
notes.content: BattleLore: Command is now available for $3.99 as part of the Steam Winter Sale! Command either the noble Daqan lords or the bloodthirsty and demonic Uthuk Y’llan in skirmishes against a friend, or embark on a full-length, single-player campaign to save Terrinoth from the Uthuk Y’llan. Whether you’ve never played BattleLore before or have long been a fan of the board game, BattleLore: Command brings tactical excitement and heated combat to your digital device.

notes.title: BattleLore: Command now $3.99!
notes.content:
As part of the Steam Exploration Sale we've reduced the price of BattleLore: Command from $9.99 to $3.99! Lead armies of charging cavalry, fearless warriors, and vicious demons into fierce and fantastical battles. Set in the same universe as Runebound, BattleLore: Command features both campaign and multiplayer gameplay in which you can choose your army, choose your scenario, and wage war against a friend located anywhere in the world.

Sale ends Dec. 1st, download BattleLore: Command today!

notes.title: v1.2.1 Update
notes.content: We've updated BattleLore: Command to version 1.2.1! This update addresses a couple of minor bug fixes - most notably the win/loss notification that fires at the end of a battle. Please update to v1.2.1 (120017) to ensure online multiplayer compatibility.

notes.title: BattleLore: Command now live! Thank you!
notes.content:
Hello everyone! We're so grateful to all of you for your support over the last several months during our PC development of BattleLore: Command! The PC and Mac builds went live yesterday on Steam, along with our Locust DLC content and we couldn't be more thrilled! BLC is a direct port of our mobile game, which was released last Nov., and now includes cross-platform multiplayer support!

Thanks so much to all of you who voted for us on Greenlight, and extra special thanks to our beta testers who helped us polish up the release build. We're dedicated to providing you the BEST possible game experiences and will continue to support BLC for years to come!
